grade_legend.purple: approved frozen composite reference; never edit
grade_legend.blue: composite needing diagnosis and repair; not a reference or blanket replacement target
grade_legend.pink: composite needing smaller edits; not a reference
grade_legend.yellow: preserve drawing; local edits only; not a reference
grade_legend.orange: preserve useful drawing; local edits only; not a reference

protected.reason: related form remains outside this one-glyph draft

structural_hard_constraints: no original font data may mutate before an explicit Apply
a detached candidate may differ only in the selected Regular target
candidate preserves target advance, anchors, components, and metadata unless an exception is recorded
protected and unknown glyphs are not mutation targets
design_preferences: reuse a relevant green construction before tracing a reference image
retain deliberate chamfers and extrema/handle structure
prefer smooth joins and perceived weight over round-looking coordinates

grid_policy.optical_refinement: a bounded detached candidate may make finer 2-unit adjustments after structural constraints hold
grid_policy.apply_and_grade: explicit selection is required for Apply; only a human may set green

candidate_budget.apply: one explicitly selected candidate as one undo group

arabic_contextual.integration_requirement: supply actual Unicode text and shaped occurrences; these labels do not establish Arabic shaping

outcomes.accepted: detached ungraded candidate is proofed and awaits human review

abstain.effect: do not apply; retain prior evidence and candidate state
